request.style: English, male acoustic voice, solo, warm and storytelling tone, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, soft drums, mood hopeful and reverent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Elijah found him plowing deep
Twelve yoke of oxen by his feet
He threw his cloak across the boy
Elisha left the team to go
He killed the oxen and ate with all
Then followed on to serve them all

[Chorus]
A double portion of the spirit
Given to the prophet's heir
The chariot of fire rose above
And he received the power
to cross

[Verse]
Naaman came with silver and gold
A mighty man with leprosy told
Wash seven times in the Jordan stream
His flesh returned like a young boy's dream
The widow's jar of oil was full
She sold the oil to keep them whole

[Chorus]
A double portion of the spirit
Given to the prophet's heir
The chariot of fire rose above
And he received the power
to cross

[Verse]
The Shunammite's son lay on the bed
Elisha prayed inside the shed
He lay on him and breathed his life
The boy sneezed seven times and opened eyes
The Syrian army was struck with blind
Led to Samaria for a feast of kind

[Chorus]
A double portion of the spirit
Given to the prophet's heir
The chariot of fire rose above
And he received the power
to cross

[Outro]
Where is the God of Elijah
The waters divide to the right and left
